S0.name: Pre-Governance (Retroactive)
S0.goal: All work done before governance layer existed. Retroactively registered.

S1.name: Governance Setup
S1.goal: Establish governance layer, seed registries, build dev dashboard, clear doc debt.

S2.name: Intelligent UI Implementation
S2.goal: Implement intelligence layer across all screens per Phase 7 frozen spec. Sprint A+B+C + polish + code review fixes.

S3.name: API Reality Check + Intelligent PO
S3.goal: Fix 18 API-mismatch bugs (CR-023), add API cache (CR-024), build coverage-based Intelligent PO for Request Stock + Direct Dispatch (CR-025), FEFO Batch Stock Detail (CR-015), wire reference_code as PO number (CR-025 sub-task)

items.title: Slice 1 — Read-only Screens (Hub, Hierarchy, Store Detail, Login)
items.notes: Foundation screens. Read-only. Terminology adapter built. Screen visibility matrix established.

items.title: Slice 2 — Pending Queues, Transfer Detail, Status Timeline

items.title: Slice 4 — Transfer Write Flows (Dispatch, Request, Approve, Reject, Receive, Cancel)
items.notes: All transfer mutation flows. Source selector. Confirmation dialogs. 52/52 API tests pass.

items.title: Slice 5 — Stock Adjustment, Wastage, Source Selector, Seed Shutdown
items.notes: 7 phases. Stock adjustment (Central-only), wastage (all roles), wastage report, seed data shutdown, POS API migration. 55/57 QA pass.

items.title: P17 — Amend / Withdraw / Modification

items.notes: Procurement form with vendor, batch, expiry, unit selection.

items.notes: Self-store inventory view. 14/14 FE + 11/11 BE tests pass. Hierarchy toggle deferred.

items.title: P24 — FEFO Batch Stock Detail Panel

items.title: P20-Phase2 — Stock Inventory Hierarchy Toggle
items.notes: Hierarchy toggle for Master/Central users. Heatmap, KPI, alert banner. 12/12 tests pass. ~155 lines added. | Re-QA required: useStockInventory.js hook + api.js getStockInventory param lost during repo sync. Fixed 2026-06-13. Awaiting re-test.

items.title: Intelligent UI Implementation — Sprint A+B+C + Polish
items.notes: Retroactive registration. 22+ screens upgraded, 6 new files, 26 modified. 55/55 tests PASS + 6 additional screen fixes + Procurement 3-mode upgrade. Governance gap: work started without CR registration.

items.title: Code Quality Review Fixes — Security + React Patterns
items.notes: Retroactive registration. Hardcoded secrets removed, array-index keys fixed, stale closure fixed, empty catches logged.

items.title: display_qty string causes TypeError in arithmetic operations
items.notes: POS API returns display_qty as string. Arithmetic without Number() wrapper caused toFixed() TypeError. Fixed by wrapping in Number().

items.title: API Reality Check, Data Seed & Intelligence Gap Fix
items.notes: Fix 18 API-mismatch bugs from audit. Proper control gate this time.

items.title: API Response Cache — Performance Optimization
items.notes: In-memory cache with TTL. 71→20 API calls (72% reduction). Gate waived (velocity exception).

items.title: Coverage-Based Intelligent PO — Request Stock + Direct Dispatch
items.notes: Coverage selector (3/7/10/30d), consumption-based ordering, threshold fallback, integrated dispatch table. Gate waived (velocity exception).

items.title: P28 — Production Unit Module (Production Run UI + History)
items.notes: Production Run form + audit detail + history (G-018 stub). 3 new files, 6 modified. Backend gaps: G-018 (history list API), G-019 (segment unit_cost). Owner requested 2026-06-13.

items.title: Navigation Restructure — Grouped Sidebar (INWARD / PRODUCTION / OUTWARD / REPORTS / SETTINGS)
items.notes: Grouped sidebar sections: DASHBOARD, INWARD (Vendor Management, Raw Material Master, Purchase), PRODUCTION (Sub-Recipe Master, Run Production, Production History), OUTWARD (Store Management, Product Catalog, Stock Inventory, Pending Queues, History & Ledger), REPORTS (Consumption, Wastage), SETTINGS. Renames: Vendors→Vendor Management, Ingredients→Raw Material Master, Add Stock→Purchase, Products→Product Catalog. Remove Recipe + Addon Recipe as separate nav items (absorbed into Product Catalog). Hierarchy Summary merged into Store Management.

items.title: Product Catalog Overhaul — Excel-like Bulk Editor + Inline Recipe/Addon/Sub-Recipe Linking
items.notes: Full redesign of Products page → Product Catalog. Excel-like spreadsheet UI with: inline cell editing, bulk upload (Excel import), Excel export, column toggles, mandatory category enforcement, search + filter, unsaved changes indicator, + Add Item quick row. Each product shows linked Recipe, Sub-Recipe, and Addons inline. Expand row to see ingredient BOM from sub-recipe. Category is compulsory — UX enforces without friction. Reference: owner-shared screenshot of bulk editor pattern.

items.title: Stock Inventory Split — Finished Goods vs Raw Materials Tabs
items.notes: Split Stock Inventory into tabs: Finished Goods (items with subrecipe_id / is_sub_recipe) and Raw Materials (ingredient type). Each tab shows own KPIs, own table. Optional 'All' tab for power users. Clarifies the inward/outward confusion — raw materials are inward procurement, FG is outward distribution.

items.title: Inward Screens Audit (Vendor Management, Raw Material Master, Purchase)
items.notes: UX Redesign + PO Module. IMPLEMENTED: 3 UX freezes done (Vendor master-detail, Raw Material expandable rows, PO Module 9 screens). AddStockPurchaseForm PO gate redirect DONE. By Item Need mode DONE. G-021 CLOSED. ~28h estimated.

items.title: Outward Screens Audit (Store Mgmt, Product Catalog, Stock Inventory, Pending Queues, History & Ledger)
items.notes: IMPLEMENTED 2026-06-14. StoreManagement unified view (Summary tab killed), ProductCatalogue 5 tabs with Recipe BOM editor, StockInventory expandable rows, PendingQueues O-13 fix, HistoryLedger O-15 fix, StockInventory O-9/10/11 fixes.

items.title: Action Screens Audit (Direct Dispatch, Request Stock, Stock Adjustment, Wastage Entry, Transfer Detail)
items.notes: IMPLEMENTED 2026-06-14. WastageEntry monthly context+anomaly+negative warning, RequestStock Central guidance, TransferDetail FROM fix+post-action projection+tooltips, ReceiveDialog partial explanation, ApproveWave hold explanation, DirectDispatch button text.

items.title: Recipe & Sub-Recipe API Contract Fix (POS Field Name Mismatch)
items.notes: POS API expects different field names than frontend sends. sub_recipe_name (not name), subunit (not unit), ingredient (singular for create), {id,qty,unit} format. Recipe name must be food_id integer. Investigation completed 2026-06-14.

items.title: Store Creation — 2-Step Create & Push Flow + Outlet Visibility
items.notes: CLOSED: 2-step wizard + outlet visibility. 8/8 QA pass. Owner signed off 2026-06-14.

items.title: Duplicate Ingredient Selection Allowed in Recipe & Sub-Recipe BOM
items.notes: CLOSED: Added .filter() to exclude already-selected ingredient IDs from dropdown options. Verified 49→48→47 count reduction. Owner signed off 2026-06-14.

items.title: Push status '125 items behind' is misleading (push-form API gap)
items.notes: UNBLOCKED: G-023 resolved. Backend now returns push_summary with total_behind + status + breakdown. Frontend needs to read push_summary instead of manual computation in StoreManagement.jsx.

items.title: Stock Inventory should split FG (Outward) / RM (Inward)
items.notes: Owner approved unfreeze of screenVisibility.js for this change. Add RM Stock under Inward, default Outward to FG.

items.notes: Replace Dialog with Sheet component for food edit. Table stays visible, edit form slides in from right. Quick Info shows linked recipe + FG stock. Mock at /__dev/previews/FOOD_EDIT_PATTERN_COMPARISON.html.

items.title: Raw Material Master — Sub-recipe items/categories contaminating Ingredients view
items.notes: 5 sub-issues FIXED: (1) Filtered sub-recipe items from list, (2) Hidden 'Sub Recipe' from category dropdowns, (3) Hidden from Categories tab + replaced delete with toggle, (4) Filter dropdown auto-resolved, (5) 'Used In' column counts recipe+sub-recipe usage. QA 15/15 PASS.

items.title: Raw Material Master — Consumption & Days of Stock calculation wildly incorrect
items.notes: FIXED: Switched from purchase-history-based consumption to daily-consumption-report API. Uses display_qty for stock. Normalizes units (gm→kg). QA PASS.

items.title: Purchase Order Create — Sub-recipe contamination + UX issues (search, cheapest, rate, columns, vendor selection)
items.notes: 9 sub-issues FIXED: sub-recipe filter, search field, cheapest rendering, Expected Rate read-only, vendor picker for no-history, column renames, tooltip. QA PASS.

items.title: Raw Material Master — Consumption still 0.0 kg/day (ingredient_id join mismatch with consumption API)
items.notes: Residual from BUG-027 fix. daily-consumption-report returns ingredient_id that doesn't match inventory_master_id from stock-inventory. Whole Wheat Flour: 0.0 kg/day, 3116d. Need to join by ingredient_name fallback or investigate ID mapping.

items.title: PO Create — Residual: send rate=0 to API, display_qty not cal_quantity, consumption/DoC wrong, search missing on By Item Need
items.notes: 6 sub-issues: (2a) Expected Rate display-only, always send 0 to API for both modes, (2b) Stock shows cal_quantity (29865 kg) not display_qty (29.87 kg), (2c) DoC shows 995d — same consumption bug, (2d) Search bar only on By Vendor not By Item Need, (2e/2f) Same display_qty+DoC on By Item Need.

items.title: RM Stock page — Remove All/FG tabs (RM only), hide Sub Recipe from category filter
items.notes: 2 sub-issues: (3a) /inventory?type=raw should only show Raw Materials tab — remove All(75) and Finished Goods(31) tabs, (3b) Categories filter dropdown shows 'Sub Recipe (31)' — should be hidden.

items.title: Stock Inventory expanded row — Expiry Risk inline date, hide Adjust Stock, load FEFO segments
items.notes: 3 sub-issues: (4) Expiry Risk column shows 'View detail' — should show closest batch expiry date inline, (5a) Hide 'Adjust Stock' quick action button from expanded row, (5b) Expanded row shows 'No segments' but full detail has FEFO segments — load segments in expanded view.

items.title: Stock Inventory Quick Actions — Dispatch/Wastage don't pre-select ingredient
items.notes: 2 sub-issues: (6a) Clicking Dispatch from expanded row should pre-select the ingredient on DirectDispatchForm, (6b) Clicking Record Wastage should pre-select the ingredient on WastageEntryForm. Navigation state needs to carry inventory_master_id + stock_title.

items.title: Sub-Recipe Master — Delete button → Active/Inactive toggle (backend API pending)
items.notes: Replace red 'Delete' button with active/inactive toggle switch (same pattern as Categories tab BUG-026 fix). Backend flag needed — API will be provided later. UI stub with toast.

items.title: Production History — Consumed Ingredients Qty shows dash, should show batch total with unit normalization
items.notes: 2 sub-issues: (8a) Ingredient-level Qty shows '—' but batch-level shows 1000.00 — should sum batches and show total at ingredient level without expanding, (8b) Normalize units when summing across batches (e.g. gm+kg → kg).

items.title: App-Wide Consumption Unit Mismatch — gm values displayed/calculated as kg (causes 1000x over-ordering in PO Create)
items.notes: 4 bug sub-classes: (1) .toFixed(1) precision truncation, (2) gm value with kg label + unit-mismatched calculations in PO Create, (3) parseFloat/Number unit stripping in Dispatch/Request/Production, (4) ambiguous unit scale in StockInventory expanded row. Root cause: POS API returns consumption in base unit (gm/ml) but frontend uses display unit (kg/ltr) without conversion. Related: BUG-029, BUG-030, G-020.

items.title: Food Categories Not Showing — getFoodCategories() doesn't extract r.data.categories
items.notes: API returns {categories:[...]} but code does Array.isArray(r.data) which is false for objects. 1-line fix. Related: CR-012 (CLOSED, different scope).

items.title: PO List — Items Column Empty (Backend Gap: no item count in list API)
items.notes: POS API purchase-order/list has no line_count/items_count field. Transfer history has both. Backend gap — no frontend fix without N+1 calls. Workaround: hide Items column or show item_total.

items.title: PO Create Item Need — Can't Select Non-History Vendors (dropdown limited to purchase-history vendors only)
items.notes: When vendorOptions.length>0, Select only shows history vendors. Other vendors excluded. Related: BUG-028 (fixed no-history case, this is partial-history case). Fix: merge vendorOptions + all vendors in dropdown.

items.title: Store Management — Indirect Outlets (Grandchildren) Show No Detail Info
items.notes: HK Outlet North/South are grandchildren (belong to Master Stores). franchise/list returns direct children only. Merged outlet objects have hardcoded email:'' and no phone/address/vendor. Stock health stuck on 'Loading'.

items.title: Transfer Detail FROM Block Empty — restaurantMap Missing Parent for Outlet Users
items.notes: CR-033 added restaurantMap lookup but map only has children. Outlet users see '—' for parent-sent transfers. Backend gap: detail API missing from/to_restaurant_name (history API has them). Fix: enhance restaurantMap to include parents via hierarchy-detail.restaurants[].

items.title: Consumption Report — Current Stock Shows Parent's Qty for Child Store Rows
items.notes: stockLookup built from logged-in user's getStockInventory(). In hierarchy view, child rows resolve to parent's stock by name. HK Express Olive Oil shows 36.1kg (parent) instead of 1.98ltr (child). Fix: use row.closing_stock in multi-store mode.

items.title: PO Create — Qty Input Allows Negative Values
items.notes: Input type=number without min=0 at lines 527,678. User can type -13. Filter excludes negatives from submission but UI allows it. Fix: add min=0 + clamp in onChange.

items.title: PO Lifecycle — Payment Info Visible Before Receive (Should Only Appear at Receive Goods)
items.notes: Owner requirement: Payment dropdown + Total should NOT appear during create/draft/approved/sent. Only at Receive Goods. Exception: By Vendor items page shows 'Expected Total' header (Qty x Expected Rate reference). Review step: remove Rate/Total/Payment. PO List: hide Payment+Total for pre-receive statuses. PO Detail: hide for non-received. Remove payment_type from create API payload.

items.title: Pending Queues — No Dispatched/In-Transit Tab for Sender to Track Sent Stock
items.notes: After dispatching, transfer disappears from sender's view. API returns dispatch_pending field (unused). Need 5th tab showing dispatched-but-not-received transfers where user is sender. CODE NONE — new tab needed.
